title: crepinella clavigera
intro: Crepinella clavigera, commonly known as the clubbed crepinella or clubbed toothfungal, is a species of fungus in the genus Crepinella. It is used in traditional medicine in various parts of the world due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepinella clavigera are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are believed to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities. However, further research is necessary to fully understand the effects of Crepinella clavigera on human health.
